marketing_description: The Milwaukee DIAMOND MAX 4‑in Tile Diamond Blade (part 49‑93‑9202) features a 0.063‑in continuous rim and a 1‑1/16‑in arbor, delivering a 4‑in cut width and up to 1‑1/2‑in depth on ceramic tile, marble, granite and porcelain. Rated for 13,300 RPM, the premium‑grade steel blade with diamond cutting edge supports dry or wet operation and is compatible with Milwaukee angle grinders.
